subject: Fix cluster Pub/Sub length truncation (#5030)
reason: The only observable change is a new "Publish message is too large for the cluster bus" error returned by PUBLISH/SPUBLISH in cluster mode when a channel+message payload reaches the ~UINT32_MAX (2^32-byte, ~4 GB) cluster-bus limit; below that boundary the size_t refactor is byte-identical to the parent, so normal-sized publishes produce no markable difference. The oversized path cannot be exercised by a fuzzer scenario: it requires transmitting a literal ~4 GB argument, which cannot be embedded as command/!!binary bytes in a scenario document and has no server-side construction shortcut (PUBLIS
